title: No self-exemption in a check

lintRule.summary: A check branch lets the model choose a value that exempts it from checking the decision field its sibling branches constrain

templateDiff.text: skills/micro-harness: add to the "node checks" section. A check with an `any` must constrain the decision field in every branch; a branch that tests only a field the model itself chose (for example relation "none") exempts the output from checking the field that matters. Give decisive fields an unconditional check or a second independent read, and report the check-vacuity rate (share of outputs where no check constrained the decision field) as a construction metric.

probeRequirement: Check-vacuity rate over the construction probes at or below 25% for every decision field.
caveats: Rules written from these artifacts: firing on them describes them and predicts nothing until it fires on workflows built after the rule was frozen (docs/LINT.md).
Reaches the constructor only through a new kit hash; held until after EX1 so CX3 and EX1 do not share a moving kit (owner decision 4, default).
